The framework describes .03 as \"Audience, purpose and meaning-making\". The suffix in the column name is the indicator number and not a level, because the ACSF has \"11 Indicators; two each for Learning, Reading, Writing and Oral Communication and three for Numeracy\". INITIAL_READING_04 holds the other reading indicator, and the AMEP file carries no numeracy indicators, .09 to .11, because the program teaches English.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (full framework, Table 3: ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Initial ACSF assessment - Reading .03","k":"ACSF level on reading indicator .03","def":"An ACSF level: Pre Level 1, which the framework covers in a separate supplement that is not organised against Indicators, or a whole level on the framework's \"five levels of performance ranging from 1 (low level performance) to 5 (high level performance)\". The framework writes level and indicator together, so a client at level 1 on reading has achieved both 1.03 and 1.04.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (full framework, Table 3: ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"It rates meaning-making, not decoding. A client who cannot read the script at all rates low here for a reason that indicator .04 describes better, so this column on its own cannot separate low English reading from low literacy in any language.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"INITIAL_READING_04","d":"The ACSF level the client reached at their first assessment on reading indicator .04.","full":"The ACSF level the client reached at their first assessment on reading indicator .04. The framework describes .04 as \"Reading strategies\". The suffix in the column name is the indicator number and not a level, because the ACSF has \"11 Indicators; two each for Learning, Reading, Writing and Oral Communication and three for Numeracy\". INITIAL_READING_03 holds the other reading indicator, and the AMEP file carries no numeracy indicators, .09 to .11, because the program teaches English.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (full framework, Table 3: ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Initial ACSF assessment - Reading .04","k":"ACSF level on reading indicator .04","def":"An ACSF level: Pre Level 1, which the framework covers in a separate supplement that is not organised against Indicators, or a whole level on the framework's \"five levels of performance ranging from 1 (low level performance) to 5 (high level performance)\". The framework writes level and indicator together, so a client at level 1 on reading has achieved both 1.03 and 1.04.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (full framework, Table 3: ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"A strategies rating is not a reading level for reporting. The AMEP KPI the ANAO describes counted indicator gains per 200 hours of tuition, so movement on this one column is a contract unit rather than a statement about a client's literacy.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"INITIAL_STREAM","d":"The AMEP stream the client was first placed in under the contracts that started on 1 July 2017.","full":"The AMEP stream the client was first placed in under the contracts that started on 1 July 2017. The ANAO records two of them, with the department's attainment target applying \"to both the pre-employment stream and the social stream\": pre-employment aims at work readiness and social at settlement English. CURRENT_STREAM on the same row is the stream as at the reporting date, which the metadata places before 1 July 2019, so the pair shows whether a client moved between the two.","dsrc":"Australian National Audit Office, performance audit 'Administration of the Adult Migrant English Program Contracts'","durl":"https://www.anao.gov.au/work/performance-audit/administration-the-adult-migrant-english-program-contracts","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Stream type client first assigned to - under contract from 1 July 2017","k":"AMEP stream first assigned","def":"A coded stream, one value per client, populated only for clients placed under the 2017 contracts. The code list is not published with the data item list.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian National Audit Office, performance audit 'Administration of the Adult Migrant English Program Contracts'","url":"https://www.anao.gov.au/work/performance-audit/administration-the-adult-migrant-english-program-contracts","lim":"A blank means the client predates the streamed model rather than that they had no stream. Providers with small enrolments were also allowed blended classes holding students from both streams, so the recorded stream is an administrative assignment and not a description of the teaching the client sat in.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"INITIAL_VISA_GRANT_DATE","d":"The day the client's first visa was granted, held on the AMEP record because the visa start date sets their program deadlines.","full":"The day the client's first visa was granted, held on the AMEP record because the visa start date sets their program deadlines. Home Affairs splits clients on it: those whose eligible visa started on or before 1 October 2020 \"can stay in the AMEP until you reach a vocational level of English\" with no time limits, while later starters must register within six months, start within twelve and finish within five years. Read with VISA_SUBCLASS, VISA_MIGRATION_CATEGORY and LEGISLATIVE_ELIGIBILITY it says which eligibility regime a client falls under.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program - About the program","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Visa information - Date when initial visa granted","k":"Date the client's initial visa was granted","def":"A calendar date, one value per client, taken from departmental visa records rather than client report.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program - About the program","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","lim":"It is the first visa, not necessarily the AMEP-eligible one. A client who arrived on a student or visitor visa and later took a permanent visa carries the earlier grant date here, so using it as the eligible visa start date puts them under the wrong deadline rule and can make an on-time enrolment look late.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"INITIAL_WRITING_05","d":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .05, audience, purpose and meaning-making, at the assessment taken when they entered the program.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .05, audience, purpose and meaning-making, at the assessment taken when they entered the program. Indicator .05 is the composing half of writing: whether the client can produce a text that suits its reader and its purpose, as distinct from indicator .06, which covers the mechanics. The Australian Core Skills Framework \"describes each of the five core skills of learning, reading, writing, oral communication and numeracy across five levels of performance ranging from one (low level performance) to five (high level performance)\" (Department of Employment and Workplace Relations).","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Key features of the ACSF","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/foundation-skills/australian-core-skills-framework-acsf/key-features-acsf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Initial ACSF assessment - Writing .05","k":"ACSF level for Writing indicator .05 (initial assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Key features of the ACSF","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/foundation-skills/australian-core-skills-framework-acsf/key-features-acsf","lim":"An empty cell is usually a contract effect rather than a weak writer. The initial ACSF assessment was only recorded under the AMEP contract from 1 July 2017 and only for new clients, so anyone who entered before then has an ASLPR entry rating in this table and nothing here.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"INITIAL_WRITING_06","d":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .06, \"The mechanics of writing\", at their entry assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .06, \"The mechanics of writing\", at their entry assessment. This is the handwriting, spelling, punctuation and layout side of writing, so a client with strong spoken English and no schooling in a Roman script can sit well below their other results here. The ACSF names indicator .06 for Writing in Table 3 of the framework.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Initial ACSF assessment - Writing .06","k":"ACSF level for Writing indicator .06 (initial assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"It cannot stand in for writing ability overall. A client can reach a level here through neat, accurate transcription while scoring lower on .05, which is where composing for a reader is judged, so reading this column alone overstates what the person can write unaided.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LANGUAGE","d":"The language the client speaks at home, recorded by the AMEP service provider at registration.","full":"The language the client speaks at home, recorded by the AMEP service provider at registration. Languages spoken at home is one of the ABS standard language variables, and the Australian Standard Classification of Languages \"is used to classify data from the ABS Census of Population and Housing and is also recommended for use in administrative data collections where data on language is collected\". The AMEP data item list publishes no code list for this column, so the coding frame has to be checked in the data.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Australian Standard Classification of Languages (ASCL)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/classifications/australian-standard-classification-languages-ascl/latest-release","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Language spoken at home by client","k":"Language spoken at home by the client","def":"A language name or code. The ABS standard for this concept is the ASCL, which since 2025 uses a four-level hierarchy and has been revised five times since 1997; the AMEP file does not state which classification or vintage it follows.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Australian Standard Classification of Languages (ASCL)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/classifications/australian-standard-classification-languages-ascl/latest-release","lim":"One language per client hides multilingualism. Many AMEP clients speak more than one language at home and arrive via a third country whose language they also use, so this column cannot support a claim about which language a client is literate in, which is what the low writing ratings in this dataset often reflect.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"LAST_TRAIN_SITE_MB_ASGS_2016","d":"The mesh block of the last AMEP training site the client attended, coded to the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The mesh block of the last AMEP training site the client attended, coded to the 2016 ASGS. It locates a classroom, not a home: the provider's delivery site is geocoded and the client's own address sits in the RESIDENTIAL columns. Read against FIRST_TRAIN_SITE_MB_ASGS_2016 it shows whether a client finished their tuition somewhere other than where they started. Mesh Blocks are \"the smallest geographical area defined by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS)\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Mesh Blocks (MB)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Mesh%20Blocks%20(MB)~10012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Last training site - Meshblock (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Mesh Block code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Mesh Block code. Mesh Blocks are the smallest area the ABS defines, and the 2016 edition contains 358,122 of them covering Australia without gaps or overlaps, including 113 non-spatial special purpose codes for Migratory-Offshore-Shipping and No Usual Address.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Mesh Blocks (MB)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Mesh%20Blocks%20(MB)~10012","lim":"It cannot count delivery. The column names where the last hours were taught, not how many hours were taught there, and a client who moved between three sites shows only the third, so a site-level count of AMEP activity cannot be built from this table.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"LAST_TRAIN_SITE_SA1_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA1 of the last AMEP training site the client attended, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA1 of the last AMEP training site the client attended, on the 2016 ASGS. At this scale a training site sits in a neighbourhood-sized area, which is fine for mapping where provision happens but says nothing about the catchment it draws from. SA1s \"have a population of between 200 and 800 people with an average population size of approximately 400 people\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 1 (SA1)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%201%20(SA1)~10013","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Last training site - SA1 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 1 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 1 code. There are 57,523 spatial SA1 regions covering Australia, each built from whole Mesh Blocks and designed to hold between 200 and 800 people, with an average of about 400.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 1 (SA1)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%201%20(SA1)~10013","lim":"An SA1 around a training site is not a socio-economic measure of the clients taught there. Joining a SEIFA index at this SA1 describes the people who live near the classroom, who are largely not the AMEP cohort, so the residential columns are the ones to use for client characteristics.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"LAST_TRAIN_SITE_SA2_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA2 of the last AMEP training site the client attended, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA2 of the last AMEP training site the client attended, on the 2016 ASGS. SA2 is the level at which ABS population estimates are published, so it is the natural scale for comparing AMEP delivery against the resident migrant population of an area. SA2s are \"medium-sized general purpose areas\" whose \"purpose is to represent a community that interacts together socially and economically\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%202%20(SA2)~10014","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Last training site - SA2 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code. There are 2,310 SA2 regions, built from whole SA1s, and the SA2 is the smallest area at which the ABS releases non-Census and intercensal statistics such as estimated resident population.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%202%20(SA2)~10014","lim":"The 2016 codes do not join to other editions on their own. SA2 boundaries were redrawn for the 2021 ASGS and differ again from 2011, so linking this column to a 2021-coded dataset needs an ABS correspondence, not a string match.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"LAST_TRAIN_SITE_SA4_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA4 of the last AMEP training site the client attended, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA4 of the last AMEP training site the client attended, on the 2016 ASGS. With only 107 regions nationally this is the coarsest of the training-site geography columns and is the one designed to line up with labour force statistics. SA4s are \"the largest sub-State regions in the Main Structure\" of the ASGS and are designed for Labour Force Survey output.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%204%20(SA4)~10016","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Last training site - SA4 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code. There are 107 SA4 regions, the largest sub-state units in the ASGS Main Structure, sized for Labour Force Survey output and so representing labour markets or groups of labour markets.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%204%20(SA4)~10016","lim":"It is too coarse to show a change of site within a city. Most capital cities span several SA4s but a client moving between two campuses of the same provider will usually stay inside one, so equality between the first and last training-site SA4 does not mean the client never moved.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"LAST_TRAIN_SITE_STATE_2016","d":"The state or territory of the last AMEP training site the client attended.","full":"The state or territory of the last AMEP training site the client attended. The data item list gives no plain description for this column, only the fuller name LAST_TRAIN_SITE_STATE_ASGS_2016, so its content has to be read from the four sibling columns that geocode the same site at finer levels. The ASGS \"brings together in one framework all of the regions which the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) and many other organisations use to collect, release and analyse geographically classified statistics\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS): Volume 1, July 2016","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/mf/1270.0.55.001","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"LAST_TRAIN_SITE_STATE_ASGS_2016","k":"2016 ASGS state and territory code","def":"A 2016 ASGS state or territory code: the six states, the Australian Capital Territory, the Northern Territory and Other Territories. Whole SA4s aggregate to state and territory, so this column is the top of the same hierarchy as the SA and Mesh Block columns beside it.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS): Volume 1, July 2016","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/mf/1270.0.55.001","lim":"A state code cannot separate metropolitan from regional delivery, and AMEP classes run at around 300 locations across Australia. Where that distinction matters, the SA4 or SA2 column on the same row carries it and this one does not.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"LATEST_ACSF_ASSESSMENT_DATE","d":"The day the client's most recent Australian Core Skills Framework assessment was conducted, which dates all eight ACSF indicator columns on the same row.","full":"The day the client's most recent Australian Core Skills Framework assessment was conducted, which dates all eight ACSF indicator columns on the same row. ACSF assessment entered the AMEP with the contract that began on 1 July 2017, so this date never falls earlier than that. The framework it dates \"describes each of the five core skills of learning, reading, writing, oral communication and numeracy across five levels of performance\".","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Key features of the ACSF","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/foundation-skills/australian-core-skills-framework-acsf/key-features-acsf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Date when latest ACSF assessment was conducted - under contract from 1 July 2017","k":"Date of the most recent ACSF assessment","def":"A calendar date. The domain is open and runs from 1 July 2017, when ACSF assessment began under the AMEP contract, to the extract date carried in DATE_EXTRACTED.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Key features of the ACSF","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/foundation-skills/australian-core-skills-framework-acsf/key-features-acsf","lim":"It does not mark the end of tuition. A client can be assessed part way through a course and keep attending for years afterwards, so the gap between this date and DATE_EXTRACTED is not time since exit, and ARMS_FLAGGED_EXIT_DATE is the column that answers that question.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ASLPR_DATE","d":"The day the client's most recent ISLPR assessment was conducted, which dates all four macro-skill ratings on the same row.","full":"The day the client's most recent ISLPR assessment was conducted, which dates all four macro-skill ratings on the same row. The evaluation records that \"On entering the AMEP, clients' English language ability is assessed using the International Second Language Proficiency Ratings (ISLPR)\", and providers reassess during and at the end of tuition. Paired with INITIAL_ASLPR_DATE it gives the window over which any rating change occurred.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Date of latest ASLPR assessment","k":"Date of the most recent ISLPR assessment","def":"A calendar date. The domain is open and can run from the late 1970s in principle, although the AMEP client records loaded into PLIDA begin in 2003, through to the extract date.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","lim":"One date covers four ratings, so it cannot show a skill reassessed on its own. If a provider updated only the speaking rating, this column still moves for listening, reading and writing, and there is no per-skill assessment date to separate them.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ASLPR_LISTEN","d":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for listening, one of the four macro skills the AMEP entry test covers.","full":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for listening, one of the four macro skills the AMEP entry test covers. The department's evaluation records that functional English is defined as \"basic social proficiency in English assessed at International Second Language Proficiency Rating (ISLPR) 2 across all four macro skills (reading, writing, listening and speaking)\". The evaluation reports that \"Most clients have a score less than 2 on all four of the ISLPR elements\" on entry, so a 2 here marks a client at the eligibility boundary on listening alone.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ASLPR assessment listening","k":"ISLPR listening rating at the most recent assessment","def":"An ISLPR rating on an ordered, non-numeric scale: 0 Zero Proficiency, 0+ Formulaic Proficiency, 1- Minimum 'Creative' Proficiency, 1 Basic Transactional Proficiency, 1+ Transactional Proficiency, 2 Basic Social Proficiency, 2+ Social Proficiency, 3 Basic 'Vocational' Proficiency and above. The steps are not equal intervals, so the ratings order clients but do not measure distance between them.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","lim":"A rating of 2 here does not make a client ineligible for the AMEP. Eligibility turns on failing to reach 2 on every one of the four macro skills, so listening alone cannot be used to reconstruct who could still enrol.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ASLPR_READ","d":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for reading.","full":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for reading. Reading and writing typically lag listening and speaking in this file, and clients with little prior schooling can sit at 0 on reading long after their spoken ratings have moved. The evaluation notes that the ISLPR has been used in the AMEP since the late 1970s, which is why the same column spans decades of clients.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ASLPR assessment reading","k":"ISLPR reading rating at the most recent assessment","def":"An ISLPR rating on an ordered, non-numeric scale: 0 Zero Proficiency, 0+ Formulaic Proficiency, 1- Minimum 'Creative' Proficiency, 1 Basic Transactional Proficiency, 1+ Transactional Proficiency, 2 Basic Social Proficiency, 2+ Social Proficiency, 3 Basic 'Vocational' Proficiency and above. The steps are not equal intervals, so the ratings order clients but do not measure distance between them.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","lim":"It cannot be compared with LATEST_READING_03 or LATEST_READING_04 in the same table. Those are ACSF levels from a different instrument introduced under the 2017 contract, and there is no published crosswalk between an ISLPR rating and an ACSF level.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ASLPR_SPEAK","d":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for speaking, assessed by the AMEP service provider rather than by an external test.","full":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for speaking, assessed by the AMEP service provider rather than by an external test. The evaluation describes the rating at 2 as \"Basic Social Proficiency\", meaning the client is \"Able to satisfy basic social needs, and the requirements of routine situations pertinent to own everyday commerce and recreation\". Speaking and listening are usually rated together at the same sitting.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ASLPR assessment speaking","k":"ISLPR speaking rating at the most recent assessment","def":"An ISLPR rating on an ordered, non-numeric scale: 0 Zero Proficiency, 0+ Formulaic Proficiency, 1- Minimum 'Creative' Proficiency, 1 Basic Transactional Proficiency, 1+ Transactional Proficiency, 2 Basic Social Proficiency, 2+ Social Proficiency, 3 Basic 'Vocational' Proficiency and above. The steps are not equal intervals, so the ratings order clients but do not measure distance between them.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","lim":"It is the latest rating held, not the rating at exit. A client still enrolled at the extract date will have this value overwritten in a later vintage of the file, so a series built by stacking extracts measures reassessment activity as much as learning.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ASLPR_WRITE","d":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for writing, one of the two written skills in the four-element ISLPR assessment.","full":"The client's most recent ISLPR rating for writing, one of the two written skills in the four-element ISLPR assessment. The evaluation reports the share of enrolments entering at 0 or 0/0+ across all ISLPR elements precisely because the bottom of the scale is crowded, which matters when this column is used as a starting point.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ASLPR assessment writing","k":"ISLPR writing rating at the most recent assessment","def":"An ISLPR rating on an ordered, non-numeric scale: 0 Zero Proficiency, 0+ Formulaic Proficiency, 1- Minimum 'Creative' Proficiency, 1 Basic Transactional Proficiency, 1+ Transactional Proficiency, 2 Basic Social Proficiency, 2+ Social Proficiency, 3 Basic 'Vocational' Proficiency and above. The steps are not equal intervals, so the ratings order clients but do not measure distance between them.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, AMEP Evaluation (ACIL Allen Consulting, 2015)","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/amep-evalution-report.pdf","lim":"Recoding the ratings to integers will distort any gain. The steps 0, 0+, 1- and 1 are ordered categories of unequal size, so treating a move from 0 to 0+ as one unit and a move from 1+ to 2 as another unit assumes an interval scale the ISLPR does not claim.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_LEARNING_01","d":"The client's ACSF level for Learning indicator .01 at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Learning indicator .01 at their most recent assessment. The framework titles that indicator \"Active awareness of self as a learner, planning and management of learning\". Learning is one of the five ACSF core skills and is about how a person organises their own study, not about their English. Pairing this with INITIAL_LEARNING_01 is the only way to read a change.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Learning .01","k":"ACSF level for Learning indicator .01 (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"It is not an exit result. The word latest means most recent at the extract date, so for a client still enrolled the value will move in the next extract, and a difference between two vintages of the file is not a difference between two people.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_LEARNING_02","d":"The client's ACSF level for Learning indicator .02 at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Learning indicator .02 at their most recent assessment. The framework titles it \"Acquisition and application of practical strategies that facilitate learning\". Where .01 is about awareness and planning, .02 is about the strategies the client actually uses, so the two move together but are scored separately. Both are set at one assessment event dated by LATEST_ACSF_ASSESSMENT_DATE.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Learning .02","k":"ACSF level for Learning indicator .02 (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"The column carries no date of its own. All ten ACSF indicator columns in this table share one assessment date, so you cannot tell whether learning was reassessed at the same sitting as reading or writing, or carried forward from an earlier one.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ORAL_COMMUNICATION_07","d":"The client's ACSF level for Oral communication indicator .07, which the framework titles simply \"Speaking\", at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Oral communication indicator .07, which the framework titles simply \"Speaking\", at their most recent assessment. The framework states that \"In the ACSF, Oral Communication has been divided into two areas -speaking and listening\", and this column is the speaking half. It is scored by the AMEP service provider's assessor against the ACSF level descriptors, not by a test score.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Oral communication .07","k":"ACSF level for Oral communication indicator .07, Speaking (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"Do not read it beside LATEST_ASLPR_SPEAK as though they were the same scale. One is an ACSF level from 1 to 5 and the other is an ISLPR rating running 0, 0+, 1-, 1, 1+, 2 and upwards, and no published concordance maps one onto the other.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_ORAL_COMMUNICATION_08","d":"The client's ACSF level for Oral communication indicator .08, \"Listening\", at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Oral communication indicator .08, \"Listening\", at their most recent assessment. It is the receptive half of oral communication and is the indicator that most often sits above a client's reading and writing results, because spoken comprehension usually develops first. The framework records that \"The second Oral Communication Indicator primarily addresses listening\".","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Oral communication .08","k":"ACSF level for Oral communication indicator .08, Listening (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"A strong listening level says nothing about literacy. A client can reach the top of this column while remaining at ACSF Pre Level 1 on Reading .03 and Writing .05, so a single oral result cannot support a claim about English proficiency overall.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_READING_03","d":"The client's ACSF level for Reading indicator .03, \"Audience, purpose and meaning-making\", at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Reading indicator .03, \"Audience, purpose and meaning-making\", at their most recent assessment. This indicator judges whether the client gets the meaning a text is built to carry, including who wrote it and why, rather than whether they can decode the words. Its pair, .04, covers the strategies used to get there.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Reading .03","k":"ACSF level for Reading indicator .03 (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"The number does not carry the text it was judged on. ACSF levels are set against four performance variables, including text complexity and familiarity with context, none of which are recorded here, so two clients at level 2 were not necessarily assessed on comparable material.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_READING_04","d":"The client's ACSF level for Reading indicator .04, \"Reading strategies\", at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Reading indicator .04, \"Reading strategies\", at their most recent assessment. It covers the mechanics of getting through a text, such as decoding, skimming, using headings and working out unfamiliar words, and is the indicator most affected by whether a client has read in a Roman script before.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Reading .04","k":"ACSF level for Reading indicator .04, Reading strategies (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"There is no numeracy counterpart in this table. The ACSF also numbers indicators .09, .10 and .11 for numeracy, and AMEP records none of them, so this file cannot support a language, literacy and numeracy profile in the full ACSF sense.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_WRITING_05","d":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .05 at their most recent assessment, covering audience, purpose and meaning-making in writing.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .05 at their most recent assessment, covering audience, purpose and meaning-making in writing. Read against INITIAL_WRITING_05 it is the closest thing in the file to a measured writing gain. The ACSF numbers a result by level and indicator together: \"The Indicators are numbered according to the core skill, using a decimal system in which the whole number refers to the level and the decimal component to the core skill\".","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Writing .05","k":"ACSF level for Writing indicator .05 (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Australian Core Skills Framework (Table 3, ACSF Performance Indicators)","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/download/6976/australian-core-skills-framework/10893/australian-core-skills-framework/pdf","lim":"A gain calculated against the initial column will be missing for most of the file. Initial ACSF assessment was recorded under the contract from 1 July 2017 for new clients only, so long-standing clients have a latest value with no baseline to subtract.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LATEST_WRITING_06","d":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .06, the mechanics of writing, at their most recent assessment.","full":"The client's ACSF level for Writing indicator .06, the mechanics of writing, at their most recent assessment. Of the eight latest-assessment ACSF columns in this table it is the one most likely to sit at Pre Level 1 for clients with little prior schooling, because it depends on script and handwriting rather than on spoken English.","dsrc":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Key features of the ACSF","durl":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/foundation-skills/australian-core-skills-framework-acsf/key-features-acsf","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Latest ACSF assessment - Writing .06","k":"ACSF level for Writing indicator .06, mechanics of writing (most recent assessment)","def":"An ACSF level for one performance indicator: Pre Level 1, or a whole number from 1 to 5. The framework numbers a result by joining the level to the indicator, so a Learning result at level 3 is written 3.01 or 3.02; this column carries the level for its own indicator only.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, Key features of the ACSF","url":"https://www.dewr.gov.au/foundation-skills/australian-core-skills-framework-acsf/key-features-acsf","lim":"It cannot be averaged with the other indicators into one score. The ACSF is deliberately profiled by core skill, and a mean across .01 to .08 has no standing in the framework and would hide exactly the spread this indicator exposes.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-english-03-19 / amep_englishproficiency"]},{"n":"LEGISLATIVE_ELIGIBILITY","d":"Whether the client's access to the AMEP rests on the Immigration (Education) Act 1971 or on departmental policy that extends the program beyond the statutory group.","full":"Whether the client's access to the AMEP rests on the Immigration (Education) Act 1971 or on departmental policy that extends the program beyond the statutory group. The Act is the instrument that carried the entitlement, and the department records that legislative reforms in April 2021 updated it to \"remove the old, 510 hour limit on free English tuition\" and to \"extend eligibility from functional English to vocational English\". A policy-eligible client can therefore hold quite different entitlement and time limits from a legislated one.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: Background","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program/background","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Visa information - Client's eligibility for AMEP: eligible via legislation or eligible via policy","k":"Basis of the client's AMEP eligibility: legislation or policy","def":"A two-way categorical: eligible via legislation, or eligible via policy. The legislated route runs through the Immigration (Education) Act 1971 and the visa classes specified under it; the policy route covers groups the department admits administratively.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: Background","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program/background","lim":"It does not give the entitlement itself. Hours, the entitlement end date and the override flags are carried by ENTITLEMENT_END_DATE and the hours columns, and a client marked eligible under legislation before April 2021 sat under a different statutory regime from one marked the same way afterwards, which this single field cannot show.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"MONTH_OF_BIRTH","d":"The calendar month the client was born in, held alongside YEAR_OF_BIRTH with no day of birth anywhere in the table.","full":"The calendar month the client was born in, held alongside YEAR_OF_BIRTH with no day of birth anywhere in the table. Month and year together give age to within a month at any event date, which is what the AGE_GROUP_AT_REGISTRATION column is derived from. Withholding the day is the usual treatment for a date of birth in a PLIDA administrative product, where the linking is done on the spine rather than on identifiers inside each dataset.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Month of birth","k":"Calendar month of birth (1 to 12)","def":"An integer from 1 to 12, or a name or code for the month. It is one half of a partial date of birth; the other half is YEAR_OF_BIRTH and there is no day component.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Person Level Integrated Data Asset (PLIDA)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/person-level-integrated-data-asset-plida","lim":"It cannot give an exact age or an exact birthday, so anything keyed to a birthday, such as a cut-off at the day a client turned 18 for the visa charge rules, is out of reach. Age calculated from month and year is right to within one month and wrong at the boundary.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"OCCUPATION_AT_REGISTRATION","d":"The occupation the client reported for themselves when registering with the AMEP.","full":"The occupation the client reported for themselves when registering with the AMEP. It is their occupation in Australia at that moment, not the job they held before migrating. The custodian marks it as self reported, so it is what the client told the provider and was not verified. The national standard for this concept over the period covered is ANZSCO, first established in 2006 and revised five times to 2022, but the AMEP data item list does not say whether this column is coded to it.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ANZSCO - Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations, 2022","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/classifications/anzsco-australian-and-new-zealand-standard-classification-occupations/2022","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Occupation at time of registration with AMEP (self reporting)","k":"Client-reported occupation at AMEP registration","def":"An occupation description or code. ANZSCO is the ABS and Stats NZ standard used for the collection, publication and analysis of occupation statistics in Australia over the years this table covers; the AMEP coding frame for the column is not published.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ANZSCO - Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations, 2022","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/classifications/anzsco-australian-and-new-zealand-standard-classification-occupations/2022","lim":"Most AMEP clients have just arrived, so a blank or a not-employed value here is the common case and is not evidence about skills. EMP_STATUS_AT_REGISTRATION is the column that separates not employed from not reported, and this one cannot.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"OCCUPATION_PRE_MIGRATION","d":"The occupation the client says they held before coming to Australia, collected once at registration and never updated.","full":"The occupation the client says they held before coming to Australia, collected once at registration and never updated. It is the field that carries a client's overseas human capital, so it is the natural pair for YEARS_OF_TERTIARY_STUDY and HIGHEST_QUAL_AT_REGISTRATION when asking whether prior skills are being used here. Like the registration occupation column it is self reported and unverified.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ANZSCO - Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations, 2022","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/classifications/anzsco-australian-and-new-zealand-standard-classification-occupations/2022","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Occupation pre-migration (self reporting)","k":"Client-reported occupation before migrating to Australia","def":"An occupation description or code, referring to a job held outside Australia. The ABS standard for occupation over this period is ANZSCO, published for the collection, publication and analysis of occupation statistics; the AMEP file does not state its own frame.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ANZSCO - Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations, 2022","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/classifications/anzsco-australian-and-new-zealand-standard-classification-occupations/2022","lim":"It cannot be read as evidence of recognised qualifications or of licensing in Australia. A client reporting an occupation such as nurse or engineer may hold no Australian registration, and nothing in this table records recognition, so a comparison of pre-migration and current occupation measures reported roles rather than deskilling.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"PRESENT_30_06_17","d":"A flag marking clients who had enrolled, meaning first attended, as at 30 June 2017, the last day before the new AMEP business model began.","full":"A flag marking clients who had enrolled, meaning first attended, as at 30 June 2017, the last day before the new AMEP business model began. It is the join between the two administrative regimes in this file: clients carried over on the old arrangements against those who entered under the model introduced in July 2017, which brought the two tuition streams and ACSF assessment with it. The department commissioned a separate evaluation of that 2017 business model, which is why the boundary is marked in the data.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: Background","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program/background","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Whether client enrolled (first attended) - under contract from 1 July 2017","k":"Flag: client was enrolled as at 30 June 2017","def":"A yes or no flag fixed at 30 June 2017. It is a status at one nominated day, not a count and not a date, and it never changes in later extracts.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: Background","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program/background","lim":"A negative value covers two very different people: someone who had already left the AMEP before 30 June 2017 and someone who had not yet arrived in Australia. Only INITIAL_ENROLMENT_DATE and ARMS_FLAGGED_EXIT_DATE together can separate them.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"PRINCIPAL_VISA_APPLICANT","d":"A flag saying whether the client was the primary applicant on the visa that brought them to Australia, rather than a family member included in it.","full":"A flag saying whether the client was the primary applicant on the visa that brought them to Australia, rather than a family member included in it. The department defines the primary applicant as \"the person seeking to satisfy the primary criteria for grant of the visa\" and the secondary applicant as \"a member of the family unit of the primary applicant, such as their spouse or de facto partner and/or dependent children\". In skilled streams the primary applicant is the person whose English was tested, so this flag separates two very different starting points for AMEP tuition.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Immigration and citizenship glossary","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/help-support/glossary","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Visa information - Flag to indicate client is principal visa applicant","k":"Flag: client was the primary applicant on the visa","def":"A yes or no flag on the visa recorded in VISA_SUBCLASS. It describes the client's role in that visa application, not their relationship to anyone else in this dataset.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Immigration and citizenship glossary","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/help-support/glossary","lim":"It cannot identify a family group. There is no household or application identifier in this table, so a secondary applicant cannot be joined to their principal, and the flag says nothing about who else came on the same visa.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"RECEIVING_CENTRELINK_BENEFITS","d":"Whether the client told the AMEP provider they were receiving Centrelink payments, recorded once at registration.","full":"Whether the client told the AMEP provider they were receiving Centrelink payments, recorded once at registration. It matters for tuition because the department states that \"If you receive Centrelink payments, learning English with the AMEP gives you points that count for your mutual obligation requirements\", and under the streams introduced in 2017 clients with mutual obligation requirements were not eligible for the Social English stream. It is self reported and was not checked against payment records.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Receiving Centrelink benefits (self reporting)","k":"Client-reported receipt of Centrelink payments at registration","def":"A self-reported yes or no at the registration date. It is a status at one point in time, not a payment history, and it names no payment type.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","lim":"It is not a substitute for DOMINO. A client's actual payment history, including which payment and for how long, sits in the social security data on the PLIDA spine, and this column cannot tell a JobSeeker recipient from a Parenting Payment recipient or show anyone who started receiving payments after registering.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_CENTRE","d":"The AMEP centre where the client registered, identified as a site rather than by name in the released data.","full":"The AMEP centre where the client registered, identified as a site rather than by name in the released data. Registration is done with an approved AMEP service provider, and the department reports that \"Classes are available at around 300 locations across Australia, in major cities and regional areas\", so the centre code sits inside a large and changing network. The geography columns in amep_address_2003_19 geocode this same site to the 2016 ASGS.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Centre the client registered at - registration centre","k":"AMEP centre at which the client registered","def":"A centre identifier drawn from the provider network recorded in ARMS, the AMEP administrative system. The code list is not published in the data item list and changes as contracts and sites change.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","lim":"A centre is not a provider and not a stable unit over time. Contracts were re-tendered for 2011-17 and again for the model beginning 1 July 2017, and sites opened and closed with them, so counting clients by centre across years mixes genuine change in demand with changes in the network itself.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_DATE","d":"The day the client registered with an AMEP service provider.","full":"The day the client registered with an AMEP service provider. It is the first of the program's administrative dates and precedes INITIAL_ENROLMENT_DATE, the day the client first attended. Registration is time-limited against the visa: for eligible visas starting after 1 October 2020 a client must \"register with an AMEP provider within 6 months\", \"start your course within 12 months\" and \"complete your course within 5 years\". The gap between this date and INITIAL_ARRIVAL_DATE is therefore a meaningful measure of how quickly a migrant engaged.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Date of registration with AMEP","k":"Date the client registered with the AMEP","def":"A calendar date. The domain is open and runs from the start of the AMEP records loaded into PLIDA to the extract date in DATE_EXTRACTED.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","lim":"Registering is not attending, and many who register never start. A count of registrations is not a count of participants, and the PRESENT_30_06_17 and INITIAL_ENROLMENT_DATE columns are what separate the two.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_DATE_OVERRIDE","d":"A flag showing that the client's REGISTRATION_DATE was set by the department's overrides process rather than captured when the client walked in.","full":"A flag showing that the client's REGISTRATION_DATE was set by the department's overrides process rather than captured when the client walked in. Overrides exist because registration carries deadlines against the visa start date, and the department allows for exceptions: \"In some cases, you may be allowed to register later or stay in the program longer\". Three sibling columns carry the same flag for the enrolment date and the entitlement end date.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Whether REGISTRATION DATE has been overrided through overrides process","k":"Flag: registration date was changed through the overrides process","def":"A yes or no flag attached to REGISTRATION_DATE. It records how the date came to hold its value, not what that value is.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Department of Home Affairs, Adult Migrant English Program: About the program","url":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/settling-in-australia/amep/about-the-program","lim":"It gives neither the reason for the override nor the date it replaced. A client whose registration was backdated after a provider error and one granted an extension on hardship grounds carry the same flag, and the original date is gone, so the flag cannot be used to reconstruct a corrected timeline.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_MB_ASGS_2016","d":"The mesh block of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, coded to the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The mesh block of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, coded to the 2016 ASGS. Registration is the administrative act that starts the client's AMEP clock, and it happens at a provider's office that is not always the site where classes were later held. Mesh Blocks are \"the smallest geographical area defined by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS)\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Mesh Blocks (MB)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Mesh%20Blocks%20(MB)~10012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Registration site - Meshblock (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Mesh Block code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Mesh Block code. Mesh Blocks are the smallest area the ABS defines, and the 2016 edition contains 358,122 of them covering Australia without gaps or overlaps, including 113 non-spatial special purpose codes for Migratory-Offshore-Shipping and No Usual Address.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Mesh Blocks (MB)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Mesh%20Blocks%20(MB)~10012","lim":"Registering somewhere is not attending there. A client can register at one provider's office and take every hour of tuition at a different site, so this column cannot be used as a training location; the FIRST and LAST training site columns are the ones that can.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_SA1_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA1 of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA1 of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, on the 2016 ASGS. It pins the registration point to a neighbourhood-sized area, which is useful for showing how far a provider's intake reaches when compared with the client's residential SA1 on the same row. SA1s \"have a population of between 200 and 800 people with an average population size of approximately 400 people\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 1 (SA1)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%201%20(SA1)~10013","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Registration site - SA1 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 1 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 1 code. There are 57,523 spatial SA1 regions covering Australia, each built from whole Mesh Blocks and designed to hold between 200 and 800 people, with an average of about 400.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 1 (SA1)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%201%20(SA1)~10013","lim":"The distance between this SA1 and the residential SA1 is not a travel measure. Registration can be done at an outreach session, a settlement service or a shopfront a client visited once, so a large gap between the two codes need not mean the client travelled far to study.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_SA2_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA2 of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA2 of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, on the 2016 ASGS. At community scale this column describes the provider network rather than the client, because registration sites cluster where providers hold premises. SA2s are \"medium-sized general purpose areas\" whose \"purpose is to represent a community that interacts together socially and economically\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%202%20(SA2)~10014","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Registration site - SA2 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code. There are 2,310 SA2 regions, built from whole SA1s, and the SA2 is the smallest area at which the ABS releases non-Census and intercensal statistics such as estimated resident population.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%202%20(SA2)~10014","lim":"It cannot be used to count registrations by area of residence. Aggregating clients by this SA2 counts where providers registered people, and a single busy registration office will pull in clients living across many SA2s.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_SA4_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA4 of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA4 of the site where the client registered with the AMEP, on the 2016 ASGS. Because SA4s are built to hold at least 100,000 people and to work as labour markets, this column groups registrations into regions large enough to compare with employment statistics. SA4s are \"the largest sub-State regions in the Main Structure\" of the ASGS and are designed for Labour Force Survey output.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%204%20(SA4)~10016","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Registration site - SA4 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code. There are 107 SA4 regions, the largest sub-state units in the ASGS Main Structure, sized for Labour Force Survey output and so representing labour markets or groups of labour markets.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%204%20(SA4)~10016","lim":"It cannot date the registration or place it in a contract period. The location is fixed at registration but the code is a 2016 vintage applied to the whole file, so a registration from 2003 carries a geography that did not exist at the time.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"REGISTRATION_STATE_ASGS_2016","d":"The state or territory of the site where the client registered with the AMEP.","full":"The state or territory of the site where the client registered with the AMEP. Because AMEP funding and provider contracts are administered nationally but delivered by state-based providers, this column is the usual jurisdiction split for counting registrations. The ASGS \"brings together in one framework all of the regions which the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) and many other organisations use to collect, release and analyse geographically classified statistics\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS): Volume 1, July 2016","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/mf/1270.0.55.001","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Registration site - State (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS state and territory code","def":"A 2016 ASGS state or territory code: the six states, the Australian Capital Territory, the Northern Territory and Other Territories. Someone who registered in one state and then moved interstate keeps this value unchanged, so it will disagree with RESIDENTIAL_STATE_ASGS_2016 for genuine movers and cannot itself be read as a move.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"RESIDENTIAL_MB_ASGS_2016","d":"The mesh block of the client's own residential address, coded to the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The mesh block of the client's own residential address, coded to the 2016 ASGS. Mesh Blocks are \"the smallest geographical area defined by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS)\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Mesh Blocks (MB)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Mesh%20Blocks%20(MB)~10012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Residential address - Meshblock (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Mesh Block code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Mesh Block code. Everyone in a block shares the code whether or not they live together, and the file holds one address per client, so co-residence between two AMEP clients cannot be established from a matching code.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"RESIDENTIAL_SA1_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA1 of the client's residential address, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA1 of the client's residential address, on the 2016 ASGS. An SA1-level disadvantage score attached to a client is an ecological measure, and in areas of high migrant settlement the AMEP cohort can differ sharply from the SA1 average on income, employment and English proficiency.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"RESIDENTIAL_SA2_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA2 of the client's residential address, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA2 of the client's residential address, on the 2016 ASGS. Because SA2 is the smallest area with published estimated resident population, this is the finest level at which an AMEP participation rate can be built with a sound denominator. SA2s are \"medium-sized general purpose areas\" whose \"purpose is to represent a community that interacts together socially and economically\".","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%202%20(SA2)~10014","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Residential address - SA2 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 2 code. There are 2,310 SA2 regions, built from whole SA1s, and the SA2 is the smallest area at which the ABS releases non-Census and intercensal statistics such as estimated resident population.","p":"2003 to 2019","s":"sourced","src":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%202%20(SA2)~10014","lim":"A rate built this way still needs the right denominator. Estimated resident population counts everyone in the SA2, while AMEP eligibility turns on visa and English proficiency, so dividing clients by total population understates take-up by an unknown and area-specific amount.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"RESIDENTIAL_SA4_ASGS_2016","d":"The SA4 of the client's residential address, on the 2016 ASGS.","full":"The SA4 of the client's residential address, on the 2016 ASGS. SA4s are \"the largest sub-State regions in the Main Structure\" of the ASGS and are designed for Labour Force Survey output.","dsrc":"Australian Bureau of Statistics, ASGS Volume 1, July 2016, Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/ausstats/abs@.nsf/Lookup/by%20Subject/1270.0.55.001~July%202016~Main%20Features~Statistical%20Area%20Level%204%20(SA4)~10016","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Residential address - SA4 (ASGS 2016)","k":"2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code","def":"A 2016 ASGS Statistical Area Level 4 code. The address is the one the provider held when the file was extracted, so for a client whose AMEP episode ran for years the state can belong to a period well after the tuition it is being used to describe.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-address-03-19 / amep_address_2003_19"]},{"n":"SECOND_VAC_PAYMENT","d":"The payment type recorded where the client's AMEP eligibility comes from paying the second instalment of the visa application charge.","full":"The payment type recorded where the client's AMEP eligibility comes from paying the second instalment of the visa application charge. The department's procedural guidance states that \"Applicants who were at least 18 years of age at time of application and are assessed as not having functional English at time of decision must pay the relevant second instalment of the VAC before their visa can be granted\", and that charge is what funds their English tuition. The second instalment is a visa charge paid before grant, sometimes by a sponsor, and this column records the type of that payment rather than a dollar value or any tuition cost, which the AMEP does not charge.","where":["madipge-mig-d-amep-client-03-19 / amep_cltpro_dob_visa_treated"]},{"n":"SLPT_2003","d":"SLPET tuition hours the client attended between 1 July and 31 December 2003, the opening half-year of this table.","full":"SLPET tuition hours the client attended between 1 July and 31 December 2003, the opening half-year of this table. SLPT is the Settlement Language Pathways to Employment and Training sub-programme, which sits outside the legislated AMEP entitlement: \"SLPET provides up to 200 additional hours of vocation-specific English language tuition, including up to 80 hours of work experience placement in a diverse range of industries\". The table is a panel held across columns rather than down rows: one row per client, with the same measure repeated for each period from 2003 to 2011. This first column covers six months, not twelve. The department's 2015 evaluation dates SLPET's introduction to 2008-09, so any hours in this column for the second half of 2003 came through its predecessors, the Employment Pathways Programme and Traineeships in English and Workplace Readiness.","dsrc":"Department of Home Affairs, Learn English through the Adult Migrant English Program fact sheet","durl":"https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/amep-subsite/Files/we-can-help-you-learn-english-factsheet.pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"SLPT - number of hours attended by client in 2003 (1/7/2003 - 31/12/2003)","k":"SLPET tuition hours attended in the half-year from 1 July to 31 December 2003","def":"A count of hours attended, non-negative and capped in practice by the sub-programme's 200-hour course length.
